summary: PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk filed a routine Form 6-K reporting the appointment of Deni Ratno Tama as SVP Internal Audit (Head of Internal Audit Unit), succeeding temporary head Umar Syahid, effective October 2, 2026, as notified to Indonesia's Financial Services Authority under POJK 56/POJK.04/2015. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or shareholder vote is involved. This is an ordinary internal governance notification, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle exists, and the only item to note is the routine leadership change in the audit function.
